'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Dan Kim LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Dan Kim]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name on sheet: MC comes after Q.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation]]
* '''Username:''' MrNiceGuy
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
